title: English Practice Quiz 0839
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Advanced English Usage 01: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Not only did she finish early, but she also checked the report.

Not only did she finished early, but she checked.
Not only she did finish early but also checked.
questions.explanation: The first option is correct. It follows the relevant professional practice or standard English usage.
